text:
Sam was a boy who forgot everything. He forgot his homework, his lunch, and even his shoes. His mother was always worried.

One day, his grandfather gave him an old backpack. “This is a magic backpack,” he said. “But it only works if you follow three rules. Every evening, put your things inside. Check the list. And go to bed early.”

Sam laughed. “A magic backpack? Okay!”

That evening, he put his books, his lunch, and his homework into the bag. He checked the list on his door. Then he went to bed early.

The next morning, everything was ready. He did not forget anything. At school, the teacher said, “Wonderful, Sam! You have all your homework today!”

Sam did the same thing every day. After a month, he did not need the list anymore. Good habits became natural.

He told his grandfather, “The backpack is truly magic!”

His grandfather laughed. “The bag is old, my boy. It was never magic. The magic was in you. You made a good habit.”

Sam smiled. He understood.

Moral: Small good habits can change your life.

quiz.q: Sam's grandfather gave him an old backpack.
Which of these was one of the three rules?

o: In Sam and his good habit

quiz.q: Small good ___ can change your life.
